title: Scholarship to Study Urhobo Language – Apply Now
excerpt: The Urhobo Progress Union America announces a groundbreaking scholarship program to Revive and promote the Urhobo language and culture.
content: The Urhobo Progress Union America is proud to announce a comprehensive scholarship program designed to Revive and promote the rich heritage of the Urhobo language. This initiative represents a significant investment in cultural preservation and educational advancement.
author: Urhobo Progress Union America

title: Partnership with Delta State University Strengthens Program
excerpt: DELSU collaboration ensures seamless continuation of studies for scholarship recipients.
content: Our partnership with Delta State University (DELSU) provides scholarship recipients with unprecedented opportunities for advanced study and research in Urhobo language and culture.
author: Dr. Victor Omoghene

title: Reviving Urhobo Heritage Through Education
excerpt: How language education serves as a bridge between generations and cultures.
content: The Urhobo language carries within it centuries of wisdom, tradition, and cultural identity. Through structured education programs, we ensure this heritage continues to thrive.
author: Cultural Heritage Committee

title: Application Deadline Extended to March 2024
excerpt: More time for prospective students to prepare their scholarship applications.
content: Due to overwhelming interest, we have extended the application deadline to give more qualified candidates the opportunity to apply for this transformative program.
author: Admissions Committee
